hardness.label: Hard
hardness.intro: ABCWUA's 2023 water quality report put the city average hardness at 8.44 GPG, within a range of 2.09 to 11.72 GPG. Click a neighbourhood to see what that means for your home.
hardness.reportNote: ABCWUA's 2023 water quality report gave a citywide average of 8.44 GPG (about 144 mg/L), within a range of 2.09 to 11.72 GPG. The U.S. Geological Survey rates 121 to 180 mg/L as "Hard."
hardness.footnote: Hardness is ABCWUA's citywide figure from its 2023 report; the zone each neighbourhood sits in can read higher or lower. It does not cover private wells or areas served by another utility, such as Sandia Heights (Sandia Peak Utility).
